topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Oh my god, you won't believe what we found up in the attic! Boxes and boxes of stuff, just shoved in every corner like they thought we wouldn’t notice. It’s all this old junk, like faded photos and dusty books, and I swear, there’s even a half-empty paint can. It’s a nightmare, trying to sort through it all. What if we find something... unsavory? And the thought of cleaning up after them, I just... I don’t even know where to start. I feel like we’ve been played, like this was supposed to be our fresh start and it’s just more mess. Can you come over? I really need some help and, honestly, a friend right now.
